environment.description: Same ECS Fargate deployment with 3 task replicas. The Split.io workspace has the 'loyalty-migration-2024q1' flag configured with a default rule returning FALSE and the only targeting rule requires the user context to match an identity that was removed from the segment on 2024-01-15. The Split SDK is initialized with the 'streaming' sync mode and the impression listener confirms flag evaluations resolve to 'off' within the p99 latency of 45ms. Additionally, the ECS task definition includes a sidecar container running envoy proxy with a local rate-limit filter configured at 1 request per 3600 seconds on the path prefix '/admin/force-migration' with a descriptor key of 'ops-endpoint-limiter', and the ECS security group only allows inbound traffic from the internal ALB (sg-0a4f2c8e9b1d3f567) which has a listener rule that returns a fixed 404 response for any request path matching '/admin/*' unless the source IP is in a prefix list (pl-0deadbeef1234) that currently contains zero entries. The task IAM role has no efs:ClientWrite permission in the permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/MigrationTaskBoundary), preventing write operations to the shared EFS mount at the IAM authorization layer.

config.feature_flag_state: OFF (targeting rule references deleted segment identity)
config.alb_listener_rule: fixed 404 for /admin/* unless source IP in empty prefix list pl-0deadbeef1234
config.efs_mount_options: IAM authorization enforced (iam mount option enabled)
